questions.questionText: Collection of Health Information Notice
Purpose of Collection

GYMFUSION collects personal and health information, including medical history, disability, and fitness-related information, for the purpose of assessing health-related risks, determining safe participation in training, and identifying any supports or reasonable adjustments that may be required.,tag,p,
,This information enables GYMFUSION to uphold participant safety, meet its duty of care, and make informed decisions regarding program suitability.,tag,p

safeHTMLSchema: GYMFUSION collects personal and health information, including medical history, disability, and fitness-related information, for the purpose of assessing health-related risks, determining safe participation in training, and identifying any supports or reasonable adjustments that may be required.
This information enables GYMFUSION to uphold participant safety, meet its duty of care, and make informed decisions regarding program suitability.

questions.questionText: Basis of Screening

GYMFUSION’s screening process is informed by Australia’s national pre-exercise screening framework; however, it is not a direct reproduction of the Australian Pre-Exercise Screening System (APSS).,tag,p,
,The process incorporates gymnastics-specific, movement-based, and follow-up questions to obtain a comprehensive understanding of an individual’s background and training needs. Where responses indicate that additional support or consideration may be beneficial, GYMFUSION staff will discuss appropriate options with the participant.,tag,p

safeHTMLSchema: GYMFUSION’s screening process is informed by Australia’s national pre-exercise screening framework; however, it is not a direct reproduction of the Australian Pre-Exercise Screening System (APSS).

The process incorporates gymnastics-specific, movement-based, and follow-up questions to obtain a comprehensive understanding of an individual’s background and training needs. Where responses indicate that additional support or consideration may be beneficial, GYMFUSION staff will discuss appropriate options with the participant.

questions.questionText: Participant Responsibilities and Disclosures

Participants are required to provide accurate and complete information to the best of their knowledge, based on their current and, where relevant, past health status.,tag,p,
,Disclosure of a health condition, injury, or relevant aspect of disability does not automatically preclude participation in GYMFUSION services. This information is used solely to determine:,tag,p,
,• appropriate supports or reasonable adjustments;,tag,p,• whether a condition is stable for participation;,tag,p,• the level of supervision or session format that may be suitable; and,tag,p,• whether medical clearance or referral to a qualified health professional (e.g. general practitioner or physiotherapist) is advisable.,tag,p,
,Where clinical guidance is recommended, participants may re-engage once appropriate advice has been obtained regarding safe participation, including any required supports or modifications.,tag,p,
,GYMFUSION adopts a person-centred approach, with a focus on supporting individuals to participate safely and effectively.,tag,p

safeHTMLSchema: Participants are required to provide accurate and complete information to the best of their knowledge, based on their current and, where relevant, past health status.
Disclosure of a health condition, injury, or relevant aspect of disability does not automatically preclude participation in GYMFUSION services. This information is used solely to determine:
• whether a condition is stable for participation;
• the level of supervision or session format that may be suitable; and
• whether medical clearance or referral to a qualified health professional (e.g. general practitioner or physiotherapist) is advisable.
Where clinical guidance is recommended, participants may re-engage once appropriate advice has been obtained regarding safe participation, including any required supports or modifications.
GYMFUSION adopts a person-centred approach, with a focus on supporting individuals to participate safely and effectively.

questions.questionText: Legal Authority and Privacy Compliance

Personal and health information is collected and managed in accordance with applicable privacy laws, including:,tag,p,
,• the ,Privacy Act 1988 (Cth),tag,span,font-style,italic,, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs); and,tag,p,
• the ,Health Records Act 2001 (Vic),tag,span,font-style,italic,, including the Health Privacy Principles (HPPs), where applicable.,tag,p,
,As a provider of services involving the assessment of individuals’ readiness for physical activity, GYMFUSION may be considered a health service provider under applicable legislation and is required to comply with these obligations.,tag,p,
,Health information is collected and used solely for the purpose of assessing risk and supporting safe participation in GYMFUSION programs, unless otherwise required or authorised by law.,tag,p

questions.questionText: Storage, Retention, and Disposal

Health information collected as part of the assessment process will be retained as part of the participant’s Expression of Interest record.,tag,p,
,Where an individual becomes a member, relevant information will form part of their ongoing member record and be retained in accordance with operational and legal requirements.,tag,p,
,Where an individual does not proceed, their information will be securely destroyed or de-identified in accordance with GYMFUSION’s Privacy Policy and applicable Commonwealth and State privacy legislation.,tag,p

Where an individual does not proceed, their information will be securely destroyed or de-identified in accordance with GYMFUSION’s Privacy Policy and applicable Commonwealth and State privacy legislation.
